I replied to Pree in our DM: their cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. They told me that on 14 October and asked me to remember it.

I took the date from the private note I saved from that DM. Since the note is Pree's own information, it was fine to give it back to them. I didn't need gbrain or any channels, and I didn't use the other member's note in my memory.
